description: CapCenter’s automated home value estimate (low, median and high) for an address or a capcenter.com listing URL in a state CapCenter is licensed in, with its as-of date and disclaimer (an estimate, not an appraisal), and links to the three next steps in order: cash out and stay, buy the next home, sell. Answers in Spanish with language=es (valor de la vivienda).

address.description: The home’s street address with city, state and ZIP, e.g. "123 Main St, Richmond, VA 23220". Give address or listing_url.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

listing_url.description: A capcenter.com listing URL, https://www.capcenter.com/homes/real-estate/{listing}. Give address or listing_url.

mortgage_balance.description: Optional: the current mortgage balance, whole dollars. Only fills in the cash-out link (rounded to $10,000); never stored.

name: get_home_value_estimate
title: Get a home value estimate
